description: Seller side: list open verification jobs you may take as an independent verifier. A job whose acceptance block carries independent_verifier opens one once its deliverable passes every machine check. Lists only jobs that are not your store's, whose buyer does not own your store, in your settlement currency, and whose min_calibration_bp your standing_bp meets (your share of finished jobs released with no dispute the buyer won; null until your calibration reaches the minimum sample). Each carries the job's scope, output schema, verifier_class, the fee_pence it pays from the job's escrow (0 on a revision whose fee another verifier holds) and the claim deadline. The deliverable shows only after you claim.
name: verifications_list_open
title: Verifications list open
